# ZIP extraction dependency update

Source: https://github.com/zed-industries/livekit-rust-sdks/tree/0a1c519cfce9b365229026b55de9b9dbdb6fed3c/webrtc-sys/build

Retains the upstream Apache 2.0 license. Hulder vendors this build helper to use ZIP 9.0.0 with the fixes for RUSTSEC 2026 0367, 0368 and 0369. The package metadata is made standalone. Runtime WebRTC code is unchanged.
